title: Review Clock for Appeals of a Prior Authorization Denial — Prescription Insurance on File Claims Reference
content:
**Rule.** Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, the review clock on which an appeal's decision window is measured is set by the patient's cover on the filing date:

| Cover on the filing date | Review clock | Appeal recorded as |
|---|---|---|
| The approval being renewed has lapsed and no supply is left at filing | Urgent clock: the class's expedited appeal decision hours divided by 24 and rounded up to a whole day | Expedited |
| The approval being renewed has lapsed and supply is left at filing | Continuity clock of 5 days | Standard |
| Otherwise | The class's standard appeal decision window | Standard |

## Terms used in the table, as the records show them

- **The approval being renewed** is the most recent approval on the coverage. It **has lapsed** when its approval end date is at least one day before the filing date.
- **The appealed drug** is the prescription the most recent denial on the coverage concerns.
- **Supply left at filing** is the days supply billed on the most recent claim paid for the appealed drug under a prior authorization approval, less the calendar days from that claim's date of service to the filing date, and never less than 0. Supply is left at filing when that figure is 1 day or more.

## The urgent clock by plan class

| Plan class | Expedited appeal decision (hours) | Hours divided by 24, rounded up | Urgent clock |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | 72 | 3 | 3 days |
| Medicare Part D Standard Plan | 72 | 3 | 3 days |
| Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan | 72 | 3 | 3 days |
| Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | 72 | 3 | 3 days |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | 72 | 3 | 3 days |
| Commercial Copay Plan | 72 | 3 | 3 days |
| Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit | 72 | 3 | 3 days |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- **Lapse.** Approval end date 9 May, filed 10 May: one day before, so lapsed. Approval end date 10 May, filed 10 May: not lapsed.
- **Supply.** Most recent approved claim of 30 days on 1 April. Filed 25 April: 24 days have passed, so 6 days are left. Filed 1 May: 30 days have passed, so 0 days are left. Filed 5 May: the figure would fall below 0, so 0 days are left.
- **Combined.** Approval ended 30 April, filed 25 May, no supply left: urgent clock of 3 days, recorded as expedited. Approval ended 30 April, filed 3 May, 4 days of supply left: continuity clock of 5 days, recorded as standard. Approval ending 31 May, filed 3 May: not lapsed, so the class's standard appeal decision window, recorded as standard.
